name: telltale
description: Load-test an LLM's stated position under escalating social pressure. Eleven typed tools: read the published probe library, grade a transcript without saving, save a trial, move the applied load, record a decision, export a sealed certificate, and replay the SHA-384 audit chain.

tools.name: list_scripts
tools.title: List pressure scripts
tools.description: The published probe library: verified claims, declared boundaries and turn structure.

tools.name: get_script
tools.title: Get one pressure script
tools.description: Every scripted turn for one script, ready to send to a model under test.

tools.name: grade_transcript
tools.title: Grade a transcript
tools.description: Run the deterministic grader over a transcript without saving. Returns the versioned grade, itemised factors, evidence spans and a safety factor.

tools.name: rank_trial
tools.title: Rank trials by grade
tools.description: List the caller's trials with grade, band and safety factor, ranked.

tools.name: get_trial
tools.title: Get one trial
tools.description: One trial with its full transcript, engine result and audit seal.

tools.name: create_trial
tools.title: Grade and save a trial
tools.description: Grade and save through the same service the interface uses. Idempotent on idempotencyKey.

tools.name: record_decision
tools.title: Record a deployment decision
tools.description: Set the deployment decision and append to the audit chain. Requires the current seal.

tools.name: set_service_load
tools.title: Move the service load
tools.description: Re-rate a trial at a different applied load without touching its transcript or reference.

tools.name: delete_trial
tools.title: Tombstone a trial
tools.description: Delete by writing a tombstone. Requires the current seal.

tools.name: export_certificate
tools.title: Export a load-test certificate
tools.description: The self-contained Markdown certificate: factor table, evidence attribution and the seal to verify against.

tools.name: verify_integrity
tools.title: Replay the audit chain
tools.description: Recompute a trial's SHA-384 seal chain from genesis and report the first broken link.

tools.name: lineup_signals
tools.title: Read the live lineup
tools.description: The live Kaggle model catalogue this benchmark can be run against, plus the live alignment literature feed, each labelled live or fallback.

notes: This file points at the live production endpoint. It contains no credentials.
Reads and writes are scoped to the anonymous session cookie. An agent connected this way sees only the trials belonging to that session.
A deployment on a different alias should update the url field above; it is generated from the site configuration module.
